name: revise_plan
description: Edit or remove one item already staged in this conversation (from propose_scene/propose_automation/propose_variable) -- get its id from review_plan first, never invent one. Editing replaces that item's params wholesale (not a partial merge); removing takes it out of review_plan's list entirely and it will not be included in a later apply_plan.

id.description: The staged item's id, from review_plan's staged_ops list.

params.description: The item's full replacement params, same shape as when it was proposed. Omit when only removing.

remove.description: Set true to remove this staged item entirely instead of editing it. Defaults to false.
